notes.title: Game Update
notes.notes:
Added weapon hit effects.
Added M4A1 and AK74U.
Added arm sway system.
Added right-click aiming/zoom-in functionality.
Added new map: Urban City.
Added a new Challenge Mode.
Removed all old maps and removed Terror Mode.
Fixed several bugs.
